hero.subtitle: STAR CITIZEN MEETUP — 2025.05.03
hero.description: Join us for a special Star Citizen pilots offline meetup. Share your experience in the verse and discuss the game with fellow pilots.

items.title: Snack Time
items.description: Share food with people at your table - a great way to start conversations and make new friends.

items.title: Information Exchange
items.description: Discuss the latest Star Citizen news and share your tips and tricks with other pilots.

items.title: Networking
items.description: No more flying solo! Make new friends through board games and group activities.

items.question: Can I attend without registration?
items.answer: Sorry, due to space limitations, only registered attendees can participate.

items.question: Are you accepting additional registrations?
items.answer: Registration is currently closed as we have reached capacity.

items.question: Is there an age restriction?
items.answer: Anyone 19 years or older can participate.

items.question: I have dietary restrictions.
items.answer: Unfortunately, we cannot provide vegetarian, halal, or allergen information for this event.

items.question: Is parking available?
items.answer: We recommend using public transportation. However, we will provide information about nearby public parking lots for those who need to drive. (Parking fees not covered)

items.question: Can I cancel on-site?
items.answer: On-site cancellation is not possible. If you cannot attend, please contact us via Discord. Refunds may not be available depending on the timing.

items.question: Will dinner be provided?
items.answer: 🍗 and 🍕 will be served! We're keeping it casual with chicken and pizza to encourage mingling and participation.
